statement: Linux DualSense initialization requires successful GET 0x09 MAC, GET 0x20 firmware and GET 0x05 calibration: failed reads abort device probe. SDL on Sony device sets standard capabilities regardless of 0x03; GET 0x09 and GET 0x20 are optional/length-checked during enhanced startup, and calibration short read (<35) is ignored in favor of its non-hardware-calibration path. For third-party devices, an invalid/failed GET 0x03 capability response can exclude HIDAPI support.
